report.explanation: The operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified and contradicted by current telemetry. All sampled checkout traces returned HTTP 200 with successful downstream calls, and order metrics show 200s on /v1/orders with no 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order 1.0.0 with no prior version, so no deployment change is established. No bounded root cause is supported; hand off for further evidence.
missing_evidence: Traces or logs showing actual checkout errors (all sampled traces returned HTTP 200)
Error-rate/latency metrics for checkout and gateway routes, not only order service
Order service logs (excluded evidence ev-dc792a13d0a8b6ef-r0-order-logs) to confirm or refute errors
Deployment history showing a version change; record shows only baseline 1.0.0 with no previous version
Evidence of which order version (1.0.0 vs 2.0.0) is actually serving traffic
